title: Glowing birthday cake with candles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cake plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#c0d8f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='36' ry='5' fill='#e8f4ff'/>

  <!-- bottom cake layer -->
  <rect x='18' y='70' width='64' height='18' rx='4' fill='#f4a460'/>
  <rect x='18' y='70' width='64' height='18' rx='4' fill='none'/>
  <!-- frosting drips on bottom layer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='32' ry='5' fill='#ffb6c1'/>
  <path d='M22 70 Q24 78 26 70' fill='#ffb6c1'/>
  <path d='M32 70 Q34 80 36 70' fill='#ffb6c1'/>
  <path d='M42 70 Q44 79 46 70' fill='#ffb6c1'/>
  <path d='M54 70 Q56 80 58 70' fill='#ffb6c1'/>
  <path d='M64 70 Q66 78 68 70' fill='#ffb6c1'/>
  <path d='M74 70 Q76 77 78 70' fill='#ffb6c1'/>

  <!-- top cake layer -->
  <rect x='24' y='52' width='52' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8783c'/>
  <!-- frosting top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#ffc4d4'/>
  <path d='M28 52 Q30 59 32 52' fill='#ffc4d4'/>
  <path d='M38 52 Q40 60 42 52' fill='#ffc4d4'/>
  <path d='M48 52 Q50 61 52 52' fill='#ffc4d4'/>
  <path d='M58 52 Q60 60 62 52' fill='#ffc4d4'/>
  <path d='M68 52 Q70 58 72 52' fill='#ffc4d4'/>

  <!-- sprinkles on bottom layer -->
  <rect x='28' y='76' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#7fff00' transform='rotate(30 30 77)'/>
  <rect x='40' y='78' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffdd00' transform='rotate(-20 42 79)'/>
  <rect x='55' y='77' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#00ccff' transform='rotate(45 57 78)'/>
  <rect x='65' y='79' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff66cc' transform='rotate(-35 67 80)'/>

  <!-- sprinkles on top layer -->
  <rect x='32' y='58' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#00ff88' transform='rotate(20 34 59)'/>
  <rect x='48' y='60' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffaa00' transform='rotate(-30 50 61)'/>
  <rect x='62' y='59' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#aaff00' transform='rotate(50 64 60)'/>

  <!-- candles -->
  <!-- candle 1 -->
  <rect x='34' y='34' width='5' height='18' rx='2' fill='#66ccff'/>
  <rect x='34' y='34' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#88ddff'/>
  <!-- flame 1 -->
  <ellipse cx='36.5' cy='28' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <ellipse cx='36.5' cy='27' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#fff5b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='36.5' cy='26' rx='1.2' ry='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- candle 2 -->
  <rect x='47.5' y='30' width='5' height='22' rx='2' fill='#ff9955'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='30' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffbb77'/>
  <!-- flame 2 -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='23' rx='4.5' ry='7' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='3' ry='4.5' fill='#fff5b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='21' rx='1.4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- candle 3 -->
  <rect x='61' y='34' width='5' height='18' rx='2' fill='#99ff88'/>
  <rect x='61' y='34' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#bbffaa'/>
  <!-- flame 3 -->
  <ellipse cx='63.5' cy='28' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <ellipse cx='63.5' cy='27' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#fff5b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='63.5' cy='26' rx='1.2' ry='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- candle glow halos -->
  <circle cx='36.5' cy='28' r='8' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.15'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='23' r='10' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.15'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='28' r='8' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.15'/>
</svg>
